01 / Computer science

Weekly Schedule Maker

UNC Wilmington · Spring 2025
Desktop application

JavaJavaFXFXMLObject-oriented design

A weekly planner developed as a team project to make tasks and deadlines easier to organize. Users can create and delete events, assign priorities, and view their commitments across a Monday-to-Sunday calendar.

Weekly Schedule Maker · Application demo

Calendar Features & Input Checks

  • Weekly CalendarMonday–Sunday TableView with dates synced to the current week.
  • Conflict DetectionFlags overlapping start times on the same day.
  • Priority LevelsThree color-coded tiers show event urgency.
  • Daily RemindersLists the current day’s events at launch.
  • Event EntryA custom dialog collects day, time, description, and priority from user input.

JavaFX Architecture & Data Models

Modular Week, Day, and Event models organize the application’s data. A central ScheduleMakerController coordinates those models with the interface, using object-oriented principles including composition and inheritance.

02 / Arts Facilitation & Outreach

Arts Facilitation & Outreach

Study abroad / Internship · Dublin, IrelandConnections Arts Centre · June–August 2026

Inclusive facilitationMarket researchGoogle SheetsCanvaSocial enterprise
Project Documents
Outreach presentation (opens in a new tab)Card display (opens in a new tab)Card assortments (opens in a new tab)

At Connections Arts Centre in Dublin, I supported inclusive arts classes and helped build outreach tools for neurodivergent artists and artists with intellectual disabilities.

Inclusive Class Facilitation

Co-facilitated art, yoga, drama, and Musical Mondays; adapted activities to sensory, mobility, and communication needs; prepared accessible spaces and kept class records.

Local Outreach & Contact Database

Mapped independent bookshops, cafés, and galleries with a co-intern. Built a shared Google Sheets database of contacts, decision-makers, hours, shop aesthetics, and wholesale or consignment preferences.

Cards, Packaging & Fair Pricing

Co-developed seasonal and artist-led card assortments, recommended sustainable packaging, and researched retail margins and production costs to support fair artist compensation.

03 / Computer Science

Python Yahtzee Games

Python coursework
Two sequential programming projects

PythonControl flowListsIteration

Python Game Implementation

I completed two working Yahtzee games by filling in missing components in supplied Python code. Each project used a different approach to the same game.

01 / Project 1

Conditional Logic

Completed missing sections in a supplied program with approximately 1,000 lines of working code and 600 lines of instructions. I implemented the remaining game logic using the techniques taught at that point in the course, without data structures.

02 / Project 2

Lists & Repetition

Completed a second supplied program with approximately 700 lines of working code and 200 lines of instructions. I reformulated the game using lists to organize data and repetition structures (loops) to handle repeated operations.
